$description: Panoptes design tokens in the W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) format. Generated from tokens.json: regenerate, never edit by hand.

brand-pupil.$description: Brand constant. Near-black with a teal cast: the logo's dark ink and the app's dark ground. Same in both themes.

brand-bone.$description: Brand constant. Warm bone; the default app icon ground and the dark theme's text. Same in both themes.

brand-cobalt.$description: Brand constant. Poster cobalt; app icon grounds, marketing fields. Too dark for text on the dark theme: use focus there.

brand-red.$description: Brand constant. Signal red; the logo on dark grounds and the one primary action per screen. A fill, never body text.

brand-paper.$description: Brand constant. Neutral paper for print and presentation boards.

bg.$description: App ground: the window behind every panel. Editor and conversation panes sit on it.

surface.$description: Sidebar, title bar and inspector panels, one step off bg.

surface-raised.$description: Inputs, popovers, menus, the command palette and cards that float over bg or surface.

surface-sunken.$description: Terminal, logs and code blocks, recessed below bg.

line.$description: Hairlines between panels, rows and table cells. Decorative only.

line-strong.$description: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes) on bg and surface; at least 3:1 there.

ink.$description: Primary text and icons on bg, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

ink-muted.$description: Secondary text: metadata, file paths, timestamps, helper text. Holds 4.5:1 on every surface.

ink-faint.$description: Disabled labels and placeholder hints only, never information; at least 3:1 on bg and surface.

primary.$description: Primary action fill (Run, Approve, Merge). One per screen. Alias of brand-cobalt.

primary-hover.$description: Hover and pressed fill for primary buttons; on-primary keeps 4.8:1.

on-primary.$description: Label and icon on a primary fill (5.6:1).

red.$description: Live: the badge shown while an agent acts in your shell, and the logo's red. Never a button fill. Alias of brand-red.

on-red.$description: Label and glyph on the red Live badge (5.2:1). Never bone or white on red.

focus.$description: Focus ring (2px solid, 2px offset), the active tab marker and the selected app icon. At least 5:1 on every surface.

link.$description: Links and inline actions in text. Alias of focus.

on-focus.$description: Check marks and glyphs on a focus fill (a checked checkbox). Alias of bg.

selection.$description: Selected list row, selected text and the current search hit, behind ink.

running.$description: Status: an agent is working. Text, dot and progress on any surface; pair with the word Running.

running-soft.$description: Status pill fill behind running text.

waiting.$description: Status: an agent needs you (approval, input). Pair with the word Waiting and a hollow dot.

waiting-soft.$description: Status pill fill behind waiting text.

error.$description: Status and validation errors, failed runs, destructive text. Lighter than brand-red so the two never read as one.

error-soft.$description: Status pill and inline error fill behind error text.

done.$description: Status: finished cleanly. Pair with a check icon and the word Done, never colour alone.

done-soft.$description: Status pill fill behind done text.

diff-add.$description: Added line background in diffs, behind ink.

diff-remove.$description: Removed line background in diffs, behind ink.

scrim.$description: Backdrop behind dialogs and the command palette. Never behind text you need to read.

space-1.$description: Icon to label gap, pill padding.

space-2.$description: Gap between related controls; row padding.

space-3.$description: Control horizontal padding; list row inset.

radius-sm.$description: Buttons, inputs, pills, badges, rows, menu items.

radius-md.$description: Panels, cards, terminals, menus, popovers, the command palette.

radius-lg.$description: Dialogs and the onboarding sheet. The largest corner in the interface.

radius-icon.$description: App icon squircle, as a share of the icon's side.

radius-full.$description: Status dots and avatars only. Never pills or buttons.

control.$description: Default buttons, inputs, tabs, list rows.

control-lg.$description: Primary dialog actions, the palette input.

icon-ui.$description: Lucide icons in controls, at a 1.5px stroke.

duration-glance.$description: One cycle of the thinking motion.

duration-loop.$description: One lap of the loading motion.

mono.$value: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

display.$description: Empty states and the About window.

wordmark.$description: The name beside the mark in the title bar.

title.$description: Pane titles and the onboarding sheet.

heading.$description: Dialog titles and section headings inside panes.

caption.$description: Sidebar group headers, set in capitals.

code-sm.$description: Paths, hashes and shortcuts inline in UI.

code-strong.$description: Prompts and exit codes inside the terminal.
